name: Declared Native Bundle Production (native-attempt)
description: C02/C10 produce demo: the declared `native-attempt` route runs `native-bundle build` as one attempt — reporting the Build ID (sha256 of native-bundle.json) and a selected candidate only when the full member set is written; an out-of-profile source selects nothing.

intro: Step 1: Request a bundle within its declared profile.
narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Only the route's declared fields are checked; broader guarantees are not claimed.
narrative.moment: Complete bundle members select; out-of-profile source selects nothing.

result_message: Result: Bundle only; unsupported source selects nothing.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-attempt route producing a real native bundle, reporting the Build ID equal to sha256(native-bundle.json), and refusing to claim one for an out-of-profile source.
success_criteria: report.json carries schema mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json), a non-null selected_result and a candidate
bundle/ holds all five declared members (native-bundle.json, program.ll, program.o, proof-cert.json, program)
bad_report.json carries no build_id, no selected_result and a nonzero normalized exit_code

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native produce route end to end: run `python -m agent native-attempt` so Core builds a real mumei.native-bundle/v1 directory, assert the reported build_id is the sha256 of native-bundle.json, then show an out-of-profile source produces no claimed build_id and no selection.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_attempt/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true) and bad.mm (outside the native profile).
Step 1 runs the declared `native-attempt` route and asserts report.build_id equals sha256(native-bundle.json), a selected verifier-evidence-candidate handoff, and all five bundle members on disk.
Step 2 reruns the route on the out-of-profile source and asserts no build_id, no selection, and a nonzero normalized exit_code.
Generate evidence: attempt.log, bad.log, report.json, bad_report.json, bundle/, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: Unlike verify-attempt, the bundle is a side effect, not a stdout document — selection requires exit 0 AND a parseable Build ID AND the full declared member set.
The reported build_id is the Core-computed sha256 of native-bundle.json — the exact identity a native-recheck call pins via --expected-build-id.
native-bundle build requires the first native profile (linux/x86_64 host, atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Every step exits the pipe-and-grep form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is native-attempt-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Produce a real native bundle through native-attempt
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_attempt/src/main.mm --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/attempt.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/attempt.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json, hashlib; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-attempt-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['build_id']==hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest(); assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1'; import os; [open('{output_dir}/bundle/'+n).close() for n in ('native-bundle.json','program.ll','program.o','proof-cert.json','program')]; print('native-attempt produced bundle, build_id verified')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json), a non-null selected_result and a candidate; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-attempt exits 0; build_id matches the Core-computed record digest and the bundle directory is complete.

steps.name: Out-of-profile source produces no claimed build_id
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_attempt/src/bad.mm --bundle {output_dir}/bad_bundle --output {output_dir}/bad_report.json > {output_dir}/bad.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/bad_report.json; cat {output_dir}/bad.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bad_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-attempt-report/v1'; assert 'build_id' not in r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') not in (0, None), r['normalized']; print('out-of-profile source: no claimed build_id, no selection')"
steps.artifact_contract: bad_report.json holds mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with no build_id, no selected_result and a nonzero normalized exit_code.
steps.verifier_gate: native-attempt exits 0 with an unselected lineage; the profile rejection is a run outcome, not a static error.
